reason: This plugin is a user-facing DeepSeek Harness web utility that consolidates multi-provider usage, balance, and billing views into a sidebar panel. Evidence shows it focuses on monitoring/token-cost visualization, local usage record handling, and optional export, with no code-generation or project-automation behavior.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 侧边栏新增“Usage/Balance”面板，集中展示多供应商余额与峰谷计费用量、调用明细，并支持导出相关数据。
summaries.en: Adds a Usage/Balance panel in the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar to aggregate multi-provider balances, peak/off-peak costs, and call history, with usage data export support.

capabilities: reads provider account/balance and usage endpoints via configured credentials
aggregates token usage and peak/off-peak cost data
renders usage/billing dashboards and call logs in the web sidebar
persists usage records and pricing/cache files under user DSH data directories
exports usage history and statistics to CSV, JSON, and PNG

reasons.code: README describes a single sidebar Usage/Balance popover with five tabs covering balances, overview, monthly usage heatmap, call log, and price list.
README states the plugin uses existing provider settings/credentials (for DeepSeek, OpenRouter, etc.) and accesses account APIs to fetch multi-provider balance and usage data.
README documents local usage data files (e.g., usage-records.json, pricing.json, cache, export outputs) and CSV/JSON/PNG merge-import/export behavior.
package.json declares a DeepSeek Harness web client plugin with a Cordis patch bundle, confirming runtime UI integration.
